title: Scalar Q Chern splitting left inverse
statement: In the setting of [lem-sfb-rational-p1-scalar-chern-splittings], the explicit scalar Q biproduct map admits the stated one-sided inverse. More precisely, with the displayed lets Λ, L, T, uq and cq, there exists v with v ≫ biprod.desc uq cq = 𝟙 _.

source.place: Second identity, scalar trace base change before tensoring with q*K; one-sided inverse component.

proof.text: The shifted positive line belongs to the rational localizing category: apply line_localizing_of_preservation to the twisted-pullback preservation assertion. The proved unit_exchange_isIso helper underlying unitInversions, followed by the first-projection line isomorphism, makes secondTraceExchange invertible on this line. Transfer native exchange invertibility with secondPretraceExchangeMap_isIso, then use invertibility of the pushed-forward line comparison.

The second-projection unit/Chern map is invertible by scalar_p2_chern_splitting. The two scalar_chern_base_change component equations identify the Q-map after pullback and exchange, through the additive biproduct comparison and the source unit/line isomorphisms, with that second-projection map. Biproduct hom-ext proves this equality. Cancel the invertible exchange and biproduct comparison to conclude that the pulled-back Q-map is invertible.

The section at infinity of q satisfies infinity followed by q = identity. The derived pullback compositor and identity isomorphism identify pullback by q followed by pullback along infinity with the identity functor. Thus pullback by q reflects isomorphisms. Reflect the preceding isomorphism to the base and take its categorical inverse. Its inverse-hom equation is precisely the requested one-sided inverse.

proof_origin.place: Second identity; descend the existing second-projection splitting through proper base change, using the section at infinity to reflect isomorphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem scalar_q_chern_left_inverse
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (c : Option (PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l))
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p] (hpl : p ≠ l)
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)] [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l Y]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (δ : diagonalCompletedDomain l Y ⟶ diagonalCompletedCodomain l Y)
    (family : Family l Y) (r : Reference l Y δ family)
    (a : DiagonalTrace.completedUnit l Y ⟶
      r.tq.Rc.R.obj ((DiagonalTrace.completedLine l (ProjectiveLine Y)) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧))
    (ha : CompletedChernNormalized l r.tq.toPresentation a)
    (b : DiagonalTrace.completedUnit l (ProjectiveLine Y) ⟶
      r.t₂.Rc.R.obj ((DiagonalTrace.completedLine l (diagonalSurface Y)) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧))
    (hb : CompletedChernNormalized l r.t₂.toPresentation b) :
    let Λ := (coefficient l c).X
    let L := line l c
    let T := fun X : Scheme.{u} ↦
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules Λ X) 0).obj (L X)) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧
    let uq := scalarTwistedUnit Λ (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) (T Y) (T (ProjectiveLine Y))
      (scalarQLineIso l c k p hpl Y)
    let u₂ := scalarTwistedUnit Λ (secondProjection Y)
      (T (ProjectiveLine Y)) (T (diagonalSurface Y)) (secondLineComparison l c k p hpl Y)
    let cq := scalarQChern l c Y r a
    let c₂ := scalarP2Chern l c Y r b
    ∃ v, v ≫ biprod.desc uq cq = 𝟙 _
